tire.en: She mentions feeling tired, having a headache or a dry mouth as symptoms of dehydration.
tire.zh: 她提到感到疲劳、头痛或口干是脱水的症状。

tire.en: And finally, if you're frazzled, you feel tired or anxious because you're doing too much.
tire.zh: 最后，如果你感到精疲力竭（frazzled），你就会因为做了太多事情而感到疲倦或焦虑。

tire.en: It’s a reflection of how you were. You might have been really tired.
tire.zh: 这反映了你当时的状况。你可能真的很累。

tire.en: Tin was used in industry, and rubber became important due to things like tires and more industrialization.
tire.zh: 锡被用于工业，而由于轮胎和更多工业化的发展，橡胶变得十分重要。

tire.en: And we started to make excuses for her, like, "Oh, she's tired.
tire.zh: 我们开始为她找借口，比如，“哦，她累了。

tip.en: The most important tip I want to give you, though, is to be flexible.
tip.zh: 不过，我想给你们的最重要的建议是：保持灵活性。

tip.en: Charlotte Stirling-Reed is a child nutritionist and she has some tips for stress-free family meals.
tip.zh: 夏洛特·斯特林-里德是一位儿童营养师，她有一些关于无压力家庭聚餐的建议。

tip.en: And to think, this was a man who many had tipped to become the British Prime Minister.
tip.zh: 想想看，这曾是一个被许多人看好会成为英国首相的人。

tip.en: Now, when the FBI received the tip, they were initially skeptical.
tip.zh: 现在，当 FBI 收到这条线索时，他们起初是持怀疑态度的。

tip.en: Another important tip is to break your goals into smaller actions.
tip.zh: 另一个重要的建议是将目标拆分为更小的行动。

tiny.en: It is a tiny triangle of land floating alone in a massive blue space.
tiny.zh: 它是一小片孤零零地漂浮在广阔蓝色虚空中的三角形陆地。

tiny.en: They are snapshots. Tiny time capsules. A reflection of what people were talking about.
tiny.zh: 它们是快照，是一个个微型时间胶囊，映照出人们当时在谈论什么。

tiny.en: Dogs have a tiny muscle above their eyes that wolves simply do not have.
tiny.zh: 狗的眼睛上方有一块微小的肌肉，而狼身上根本没有这块肌肉。

tiny.en: The other Christmas Island is located in the tiny Pacific nation of Kiribati.
tiny.zh: 另一个圣诞岛位于太平洋上的微型岛国基里巴斯。

tiny.en: It's only a tiny fraction of Earth's life that has ever become fossilised.
tiny.zh: 地球历史上只有极小一部分生命变成了化石。

title.en: This title went to an older cousin, Mohammed Bin Nayef, or MBN for short.
title.zh: 这个头衔属于一位年长的表亲，穆罕默德·本·纳伊夫（简称 MBN）。

title.en: He published an article titled, “The Underground Website Where You Can Buy Any Drug Imaginable”.
title.zh: 他发表了一篇题为《在这个地下网站，你可以买到任何能想象到的毒品》的文章。

title.en: But behind the smiling portraits and grandiose titles was a deeply repressive regime.
title.zh: 但在微笑着的画像和宏大的头衔背后，是一个极其压制异己的政权。

title.en: What are they? Why were they chosen? And do they really deserve the title of “wonder”?
title.zh: 它们是什么？它们是如何被选出来的？它们真的配得上“奇迹”这个称号吗？

title.en: In 2016 Forbes Magazine published an article titled “The Rise of the Freelancer Economy”.
title.zh: 2016年，《福布斯》杂志发表了一篇题为《自由职业者经济的崛起》的文章。

tissue.en: Sometimes – and I know this could be, like, picky for everyone else – but having a tissue or napkin on your lap just in case you spill anything.
tissue.zh: 有时——我知道这对其他人来说可能有点挑剔——但在腿上放一张纸巾或餐巾，以防弄脏衣服。

tissue.en: So, how would a vaccine change things? Well, existing treatments, like chemotherapy, aggressively target the cancer, but also attack healthy tissue, creating unpleasant side effects.
tissue.zh: 那么，疫苗将如何改变现状呢？嗯，现有的治疗方法，如化疗，会强力攻击癌症，但也会攻击健康组织，从而产生令人不适的副作用。

tide.en: But Rome didn’t. And this is where the tide began to turn.
tide.zh: 但罗马没有。正是在这里，战局开始逆转。

tide.en: By 11 pm that evening, the tide had well and truly turned.
tide.zh: 到了当晚11点，局势彻底逆转。

tide.en: The idiom the tide is turning means that things are changing.
tide.zh: 习语“the tide is turning”意思是情况正在发生变化。

tide.en: And finally, people who swim against the current, or the tide, do or say things differently from most other people.
tide.zh: 最后，那些 swim against the current（或 the tide）的人，他们做的事或说的话与大多数人不同。

tide.en: Many people pay more attention to protein than fibre in their diet, but Dr Karan thinks the tide is turning – an idiom which means that things are changing.
tide.zh: 许多人在饮食中对蛋白质的关注多于纤维，但Karan博士认为“the tide is turning（风向正在转变）”——这是一个习语，意思是情况正在发生变化。

tight.en: The phrase money is tight means you only have just enough money to live.
tight.zh: 短语 money is tight 的意思是你的钱只够勉强维持生计。

tight.en: Similar to the UK, Canada and Australia are also implementing tighter visa policies, specifically for international students.
tight.zh: 与英国类似，加拿大和澳大利亚也在实施更严格的签证政策，特别是针对国际学生。

tight.en: On immigration, he has taken a very strict position, supporting tight restrictions on both legal and illegal immigration.
tight.zh: 在移民问题上，他采取了非常强硬的立场，支持对合法移民和非法移民都实施严格限制。

tight.en: The men lowered and lowered and lowered it, but after 732 metres it was still just as tight as before.
tight.zh: 船员们不断地往下放、往下放、往下放，但在732米之后，它依然像以前一样紧绷。

tight.en: Until then, you'll just need to sit tight.
tight.zh: 在那之前，你只能干等着。

tidy.en: Decluttering was popularised by Marie Kondo's best-selling 2011 book, The Life-Changing Magic of Tidying Up, and there's still lots of interest today.
tidy.zh: 断舍离是由玛丽·康多的2011年畅销书《改变S生活的神奇整理魔法》普及开来的，今天人们对它依然有着极大的兴趣。

tidy.en: I can't think or work anymore, so much so it woke me at 4 a.m. this morning and I felt a strong urge to tidy.
tidy.zh: 我再也无法思考或工作了，以至于今天早上4点把我吵醒，我感到有一种强烈的冲动想要去收拾。

tidy.en: The law that developed around this was never tidy — there was no single act of Parliament that defined it — but its purpose was consistent.
tidy.zh: 围绕这一点制定的法律从来都不是井然有序的——没有哪一部单一的议会法案对其进行过定义——但它的目的是一贯的。

tidy.en: Unfortunately, the story of Otto Warmbier does not have a tidy conclusion, in the sense that justice has not been served and accountability has not followed.
tidy.zh: 遗憾的是，奥托·瓦姆比尔的故事没有一个圆满的结局——公道没有得到伸张，也没有人为此承担责任。

tidy.en: A promise to your parents that you’d always tidy your room, or that if you got a dog, you would always take it out for a walk, even if it was raining.
tidy.zh: 比如向父母保证会永远整理房间，或者如果养了狗，哪怕下雨也一定会带它出去遛弯。

tightly.en: To cling means to stick or hold tightly onto something.
tightly.zh: To cling 的意思是紧紧粘住或抓牢某物。

tightly.en: Italy, by contrast, has held on tightly to the idea that citizenship is primarily something passed down through blood.
tightly.zh: 相比之下，意大利死死抱住“公民身份主要通过血统世代相传”的观念不放。

tightly.en: Clay soil, on the other hand, is made of smaller particles which cling, or stick together tightly, and hold water, helping plants grow.
tightly.zh: 另一方面，粘土由紧密粘连在一起的微小颗粒组成，能够保持水分，帮助植物生长。

timetable.en: He drew up the timetables for the trains that carried millions of people to the death camps.
timetable.zh: 他制定了将数百万人运往死亡集中营的列车时刻表。

tie.en: And in 1986, the Australia Act ended nearly all remaining legal ties with Britain.
tie.zh: 而在 1986 年，《澳大利亚法案》彻底结束了与英国几乎所有剩余的法律联系。

tie.en: There is no gravity on an asteroid, so everything would need to be tied down to the asteroid.
tie.zh: 小行星上没有引力，所以所有的东西都必须绑在小行星上。

tie.en: Different aspects of life often feel tied to specific languages.
tie.zh: 生活的不同方面通常感觉与特定的语言紧密相连。

tie.en: The calendar was now tied to the cycles of the Sun.
tie.zh: 日历现在与太阳的周期绑定在了一起。

tie.en: This was a new kind of mercenary force—corporate, professional, and deeply tied to modern warfare’s complex logistics.
tie.zh: 这是一种新型的雇佣兵力量——企业化、专业化，并且深深嵌入到现代战争复杂的后勤中。

tiger.en: Chua had published her book, Battle Hymn of the Tiger Mother, in 2011.
tiger.zh: 蔡美儿于2011年出版了她的书《虎妈战歌》（Battle Hymn of the Tiger Mother）。

tiger.en: It could have been a tiger, which are native to the region.
tiger.zh: 那可能是一只老虎，老虎是当地的本土动物。

tiger.en: They were largely ignored. English law in Ireland was, in other words, a paper tiger — a rule that looked powerful on paper but had no real substance when it came to enforcement.
tiger.zh: 这些法律在很大程度上被忽视了。换句话说，爱尔兰的英国法律只是一只“纸老虎”——在纸面上看起来很强大，但在执行时却毫无实质内容。

tiger.en: The second was a professor named Amy Chua, whose name you might recognise from her book about being a Tiger Mum, and how children benefit from being pushed to study, play musical instruments, and so on.
tiger.zh: 第二个是一位名叫蔡美儿（Amy Chua）的教授，你可能会从她关于“虎妈”的书籍中认出这个名字，书中讲述了孩子们如何从被逼着学习、演奏乐器等方面受益。

tickle.en: There was surely affection, as you can see in the Odyssey, but the dog’s primary function was as a worker, not as someone to lie around you next to your feet and get its tummy tickled.
tickle.zh: 正如你在《奥德赛》中看到的那样，其中肯定也有温情，但狗的主要功能是个工人，而不是趴在你脚边等着被人挠肚皮的宠物。

tick.en: Egypt in 2011 would have had a tick in the box for practically all of those things.
tick.zh: 2011 年的埃及几乎所有这些条件都符合。

tick.en: But this was also something of a ticking time bomb.
tick.zh: 但这也是一颗某种程度上的定时炸弹。

timid.en: His teachers described him as “quiet”, “withdrawn”, even “timid”.
timid.zh: 他的老师形容他“安静”、“内向”，甚至“胆小”。

tilt.en: Those further away from the Equator had warmer seasons and colder seasons when they got more or less daylight, given the fact that the Earth is on a slight tilt.
tilt.zh: 由于地球有轻微的倾斜，离赤道较远的人们在获得或多或少的日光时，会有更温暖和更寒冷的季节。

tighten.en: In fact, after the Stanford Prison Experiment, the field of psychology tightened its rules for what could and couldn’t be done in experiments.
tighten.zh: 事实上，在斯坦福监狱实验之后，心理学界收紧了关于实验中哪些事可以做、哪些不可以做的规定。

tighten.en: If you are listening to this and thinking about moving to the UK or any country with tightening immigration rules, what should you actually do?
tighten.zh: 如果你正在听这个节目，并考虑移居英国或任何移民规则收紧的国家，你实际上应该怎么做？

tighten.en: Because of this pressure, countries like the UK, Canada, Australia, and several European nations are all tightening their immigration rules at the same time.
tighten.zh: 正因为这种压力，英国、加拿大、澳大利亚和几个欧洲国家都在同时收紧移民规则。

tin.en: Beneath the DRC lies enormous deposits of copper, cobalt, gold, diamonds, tin, and coltan.
tin.zh: 刚果（金）地下蕴藏着巨额的铜、钴、黄金、钻石、锡和钶钽铁矿储量。

tin.en: Tin was used in industry, and rubber became important due to things like tires and more industrialization.
tin.zh: 锡被用于工业，而由于轮胎和更多工业化的发展，橡胶变得十分重要。

tin.en: Two particularly important products were tin and rubber.
tin.zh: 其中两个特别重要的产品是锡和橡胶。

tin.en: Istanbul likely comes from the Greek phrase “eis tin polin,” which means “into the city” or “to the city,” and over time evolved into the modern name Istanbul.
tin.zh: 伊斯坦布尔很可能源自希腊语短语“eis tin polin”，意思是“进城”或“去城里”，随着时间的推移演变成了现代名称伊斯坦布尔。

tin.en: If you look at these facts, the fact the DRC has copper, cobalt, gold, coltan, diamonds, tin, all of these different metals, you might expect the DRC to be one of the wealthiest countries in Africa.
tin.zh: 如果你看一下这些事实，即刚果（金）拥有铜、钴、黄金、钶钽铁矿、钻石、锡以及所有这些不同的金属，你可能会期望刚果（金）成为非洲最富有的国家之一。

timber.en: It has a lot of natural resources. It produces oil, natural gas, timber, minerals, agricultural products.
timber.zh: 它拥有丰富的自然资源。它生产石油、天然气、木材、矿产和农产品。

timber.en: For they took away the old planks as they decayed, putting in new and stronger timber in their places.
timber.zh: 因为他们随着旧木板的腐烂而把它们拿走，在它们的位置上换上更新更结实的木材。

timely.en: That brings us to the third key to becoming an expert: timely feedback.
timely.zh: 这就引出了成为专家的第三个关键：及时的反馈。

timely.en: So how can you get timely feedback when learning English?
timely.zh: 那么在学习英语时，你如何获得及时的反馈呢？
